verdict.rationale: Skills are plain SKILL.md files: YAML frontmatter plus Markdown, under an open spec (skills-cli-docs-16, skills-cli-docs-4). The CLI installs them into ordinary project or user directories that you can commit and share (skills-cli-gh-24, skills-cli-gh-40). The same files work across 70+ agents, and a `remove` command plus a `skills-lock.json` manifest make the setup portable and easy to dismantle (skills-cli-docs-1, skills-cli-gh-29, skills-cli-gh-14, skills-cli-docs-22). However, leaving is only implied by the local-file design: there is no documented export or exit path. missing for 10: an explicit export command or documented data-portability/exit guidance, disclosure of what data the skills.sh service itself holds (e.g., install telemetry) and whether it can be exported or deleted, independent corroboration of a clean exit.
